Mantra.title: Mantra
Mantra.description: Represents a mantra track in the application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Mantra entity.

filePath.description: File path or URL to the mantra audio file.

duration.description: Duration of the mantra track in seconds.

photoURL.description: URL of the user's profile picture.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the user profile was created.

definition.description: Stores metadata for mantra tracks. No specific access control is required.

params.name: mantraId
params.description: Unique identifier for the mantra track.

definition.description: Stores user profile information. Users can only read and write their own profile.

firestore.reasoning: The Firestore data structure is designed for simplicity and read optimization. We'll store mantra track metadata in a single public collection. User profiles will be stored in a separate `users` collection, with security rules ensuring that users can only access and modify their own data. This approach supports the freemium model while maintaining data privacy and security.
